chunks: I found her and her people prostrating to the sun instead of Allah, and Satan had made their deeds attractive to them and turned them away from the Path, so they do not find the way.

key_terms.مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ: instead of Allah / in place of God

ai.seo_question: Who did the Queen of Sheba and her people worship according to the Quran?
ai.summary: This verse highlights the psychological mechanism of divine guidance, where Satan (Shaitan) embellishes misdeeds to create spiritual blindness, a concept central to Shia exegesis regarding the interplay between free will and external temptation. It specifically references the Queen of Sheba (Bilqis), whose eventual submission to Solomon serves as a testament to the power of recognizing Tawhid amidst idolatrous practices. The narrative underscores that misguidance is not merely a lack of knowledge but an active obstruction caused by the seduction of one's own ego and Satan.
